trajectory_contract.continuity_at_breakpoints: The next piece starts at the continuous extension of the previous piece.
trajectory_contract.outside_domain_behavior: Do not clip or reflect trajectories after time zero.
trajectory_contract.breakpoint_deduplication: A repeated breakpoint is retained once.
trajectory_contract.K_definition: K = |B| + 1, where B is the set of distinct internal breakpoints across all trajectories.
trajectory_contract.continuous_mode_typical_K: K is generally n*s+1 when all internal breakpoints are distinct.
trajectory_contract.binary_mode_K: Recompute after quantization and merge equal breakpoints; record the realized K.
trajectory_contract.short_initial_intervals: Handle by the thesis FROZEN contract; do not merge by floating-point tolerance.

random_stream_contract.rejection_sampling: Resample only the component violating its domain constraint, then continue from the same random stream. The resulting conditional distribution is part of the generator.
